groups.name: composite-cache.config.composite
groups.description: 组合缓存（L1/L2 类型）配置.

groups.name: composite-cache.config.guava
groups.description: L1 Guava 配置（Caffeine 的可选替代）.

groups.name: composite-cache.config.redis
groups.description: L2 Redis（Redisson）配置：回源策略、TTL 抖动、运行期降级等.

groups.name: composite-cache.config.cache-sync-policy
groups.description: 跨节点缓存同步策略配置.

groups.name: composite-cache.config.consistency
groups.description: 一致性增强配置（默认全关，开启后才接入写/删路径）.

groups.name: composite-cache.config.penetration
groups.description: 缓存穿透增强（布隆过滤器）配置.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.instance-id
properties.description: 缓存实例 ID，用于区分不同应用实例（默认基于 UUID 自动生成）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.allow-null-values
properties.description: 是否缓存空值（NullValue）以防止缓存穿透.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.null-value-expire-time-seconds
properties.description: NullValue 过期时间（秒），用于淘汰空值.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.null-value-max-size
properties.description: NullValue 最大数量，防止内存溢出.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.null-value-clear-period-seconds
properties.description: NullValue 清理频率（秒）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.dynamic
properties.description: 是否根据 cacheName 动态创建 Cache 实例.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.cache-mode
properties.description: 缓存模式：L1（仅本地）/ L2（仅 Redis）/ L1_L2（组合，推荐）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.composite.l1-cache-type
properties.description: 一级缓存类型：CAFFEINE（推荐）/ GUAVA.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.composite.l2-cache-type
properties.description: 二级缓存类型：REDIS.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.caffeine.manual-cache
properties.description: L1 是否为手动缓存（非 LoadingCache，不走加载器/刷新）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.caffeine.auto-refresh-expire-cache
properties.description: 是否定时刷新过期缓存.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.caffeine.refresh-thread-pool-size
properties.description: 刷新调度线程池大小（默认 CPU 核数）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.caffeine.refresh-period
properties.description: 缓存刷新频率（秒）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.caffeine.publish-msg-period-milli-seconds
properties.description: 同一 key 发布同步消息的最小间隔（毫秒）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.guava.manual-cache
properties.description: L1 是否为手动缓存（非 LoadingCache）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.guava.auto-refresh-expire-cache
properties.description: 是否定时刷新过期缓存.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.guava.refresh-thread-pool-size
properties.description: 刷新调度线程池大小（默认 CPU 核数）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.guava.refresh-period
properties.description: 缓存刷新频率（秒）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.guava.publish-msg-period-milli-seconds
properties.description: 同一 key 发布同步消息的最小间隔（毫秒）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.try-lock
properties.description: LOCK 回源策略下：tryLock 快速失败（true）还是 lock 阻塞等待（false）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.load-strategy
properties.description: L2 失效后的回源策略：NONE / LOCK（分布式锁防击穿）/ LOGICAL_EXPIRE（逻辑过期）。未配置时按 lock 推导.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.logical-expire-physical-ttl-factor
properties.description: 逻辑过期模式下物理 TTL 相对逻辑 TTL 的放大倍数.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.ttl-jitter-ratio
properties.description: TTL 随机抖动比例（缓解雪崩）：实际 TTL = base + random[0, base*ratio]，0 关闭.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.degrade-enabled
properties.description: 是否启用 L2 运行期降级（熔断）：Redis 异常时读降级/写跳过、恢复自愈。开启会吞掉 L2 连接类异常.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.degrade-failure-threshold
properties.description: 连续失败达到该阈值则打开熔断.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.degrade-open-millis
properties.description: 熔断打开持续时间（毫秒），到期半开试探.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.degrade-max-concurrent-loads
properties.description: 降级期间回源 DB 的最大并发数（保护 DB），<=0 不限制.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.user-prefix
properties.description: 是否以 cacheName 作为 Redis key 前缀.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.support-batch
properties.description: 是否启用 Redis 批量管道.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.batch-size
properties.description: 批量管道分片大小.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.redisson-yaml-config
properties.description: Redisson 的 YAML 配置文件路径（可选，用于自建 RedissonClient）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.redis.lock
properties.description: 加载数据时是否加锁.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.cache-sync-policy.msg-type
properties.description: 跨节点同步消息类型。目前仅 REDIS / KAFKA 可用；ROCKETMQ / RABBITMQ 未实现（运行时抛异常）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.cache-sync-policy.topic
properties.description: 缓存同步消息的 topic 名称.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.cache-sync-policy.async
properties.description: 是否异步发送同步消息.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.cache-sync-policy.enhanced
properties.description: REDIS 同步是否使用可靠版（版本门控+去重+补偿）；false 回退基础版。仅对 msg-type=REDIS 生效.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.cache-sync-policy.enable-ack
properties.description: 可靠版策略是否启用 ACK 确认.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.cache-sync-policy.max-retries
properties.description: 可靠版策略发布失败的最大重试次数.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.consistency.delayed-double-delete
properties.description: 是否启用延迟双删（evict 后延迟再删一次，缓解主从/同步延迟脏数据）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.consistency.delayed-double-delete-millis
properties.description: 延迟双删的延迟时间（毫秒）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.consistency.delete-compensation
properties.description: 是否启用删除失败补偿（L2 删除失败记录、后台重试）。需 Redis 可用.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.consistency.delete-compensation-max-retry
properties.description: 删除补偿最大重试次数.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.consistency.delete-compensation-interval-seconds
properties.description: 删除补偿任务执行间隔（秒）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.consistency.master-slave
properties.description: 是否注册主从一致性处理器 Bean（写后强制读主，编程式使用）.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.penetration.bloom-enabled
properties.description: 是否注册布隆过滤器 Bean（默认本地 Guava）。开启后仍需按 cacheName register/warmUp 才生效.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.penetration.bloom-expected-insertions
properties.description: 布隆过滤器默认预期容量.

properties.name: composite-cache.config.penetration.bloom-fpp
properties.description: 布隆过滤器默认误判率.

values.description: 默认策略：单参数直接返回，多参数封装为 DefaultKey.
自定义策略：包含类名与方法名（推荐）.
智能策略：自动处理大对象（MD5）.
一级 + 二级组合（推荐）.
Caffeine 作为一级缓存（推荐）.
Guava 作为一级缓存（可选）.
分布式锁单飞，防缓存击穿.
逻辑过期，永不阻塞、异步刷新.
Redis Pub/Sub 同步（推荐，配合 enhanced 可靠版）.
